payload.acceptance_criteria:
The check flags a workflow line that runs a hook script only when that script calls basicly verify --mode full without --ci. It reads the script, and the message names the script.
A workflow line that calls basicly verify --mode full directly without --ci is still flagged. A script shaped like terminal's pre-push (pytest only) is not flagged.
payload.description:
## Context
When basicly check reads a consumer workflow that runs a hook script, I want it to flag the line only when the script runs basicly verify --mode full without --ci, so a pytest-only pre-push script is not reported. 0.46.4 basicly check (basicly-uora5dm.4 part b) reports terminal's quality-gates.yml lines 31 and 45 as runs the local full checks without --ci; those lines run .scripts/git-hooks/pre-push.py, which runs only uv run pytest tests/. The suggested fixes would delete the test suite from CI. Cause: the READERS pattern hooks/pre-push.py in src/basicly/ci_records.py matches any path that ends that way. Lane harness/dev-0465.
payload.title: basicly check flags a hook script that never calls verify as running the local full checks without --ci

payload.acceptance_criteria:
The kit-boundary pre-commit scans only kit files in the commit's index. An untracked kit file with a violation does not refuse the commit, and the same file staged does.
In a scratch consumer with the kit installed and committed, a tracker-only commit passes while a later kit update is unstaged.
payload.description:
## Context
When a consumer commits tracker lines while a kit update is unstaged, I want the kit-boundary pre-commit to judge only the files in the commit, so an untracked kit file does not refuse an unrelated commit. Orchestrator decision 2026-11-19 11:31 UTC, relayed by the dev session. Lane harness/dev-0465.
payload.title: kit-boundary judges untracked kit files that are not in the commit

payload.acceptance_criteria: A pre-commit hook sees exactly the commit's tree. Any file that a hook needs and the commit lacks is named by the hook, not copied in silently.
payload.description:
## Context
When a pre-commit hook runs, I want it to see exactly the commit's tree, so a hook never judges a state that is neither the commit nor the working tree. staged-snapshot.py prepare() checks out the staged index, then copies every untracked working-tree file into the snapshot. handily on 2026-11-19 at 11:28 UTC: a tracker-only commit during an unstaged 0.46.4 install; the index held kit-boundary.py from 0.45.0 while the new untracked kit files were copied in, so the old hook refused the new files. Held until after 0.46.5 (Orchestrator decision 2026-11-19 11:31 UTC). Not claimed.
payload.title: The pre-commit staged snapshot mixes untracked working-tree files into every hook

payload.text: Requirements from the workspace mail lock incident of 2026-11-18: a lock held by a background wait loop plus a merge with no unlock outlived the landing, and handily's lane waited from 22:16 UTC. The kit lock must have 4 properties. 1. It records the holder pid and an expiry (default TTL 60 minutes, settable). 2. Its listing shows the age and marks a lock stale when the pid is dead or the TTL passed. 3. lock takes over a stale lock and logs the takeover. 4. A with-lock form runs a command and releases the lock on exit, on success and on failure. The workspace fix is filed under dev-196z3 or a new dev record.
